text:
The reference device M1 is not diode-connected. Its drain is on `iin` and its gate is on `iout`, so the mirror has no self-biased reference. M1's gate sits at 0.9 V (the `iout` node), which forces M1 into triode with Vds = 0.021 V. That pulls `iin` down to about 0.02 V, which leaves M2's gate below threshold and M2 off. The fix is to tie M1's gate to `iin`, the drain of M1.

```json
{"ranking": ["M1", "M2"], "fault": "M1 gate miswired to iout instead of iin (its own drain), so the diode-connected reference is broken; M1 sits in triode with Vgs=0.9 V and pulls iin to ~0.02 V, which turns M2 off. Correct connection: M1 iin iin vss vss nfet."}
```

Only two elements are in the netlist, so the ranking has two entries.
